name: Educational Institutions
short: Teaching and non-teaching staff, academic calendars and staff payroll.
headline: HR and payroll for schools, colleges and institutes
intro: Teaching and non-teaching staff often follow different timings, salary structures and rounding rules. PayroleHR lets you set each one up the way your institution already works.
challenges: Teaching and non-teaching staff on different salary structures.
Morning and day timings for different sections.
Staff who hold two roles, such as teacher and hostel warden.
Several approval levels before salaries are released.

features.why: Separate structures for teaching and non-teaching staff, each with its own columns and rounding.
A kiosk at the staff gate replaces the attendance register.
Different timings per weekday, such as shorter Saturdays.
HR → Accounts → Principal sign-off before salaries are locked.
Casual and sick leave credited monthly or yearly.

workflow: Staff check in at the gate kiosk each morning.
The month's attendance flows into each staff group's salary structure.
Accounts reviews, the principal approves, and the bank file is exported.
Staff download payslips from the portal.

scenarios.title: Two roles, one bank transfer
scenarios.text: A teacher who is also hostel warden keeps two staff records with separate salaries; the bank file pays both in one line.

scenarios.title: Holidays and vacations
scenarios.text: Institution holidays come from your calendar. Separate vacation-period handling is planned, not available yet.

faqs.q: Can non-teaching staff salaries keep paise while teachers round?
faqs.a: Yes. Rounding is set per column in each structure.

name: Corporate Offices
short: Departments, custom roles, self-service and approvals.
headline: HR for offices that want fewer spreadsheets and emails
intro: Give employees a self-service portal, managers their own department view, and finance a payroll they can approve with confidence.
challenges: Staff asking HR for payslips and leave balances.
Managers who should see only their team.
Increments that need to take effect from a future month.

features.why: Self-registration and custom fields for each employee.
Custom roles and department-head visibility.
Scheduled salary revisions and approval stages.
HR queries tracked instead of lost in email.
Goals and reviews alongside attendance and pay.

workflow: Employees sign in to the portal with mobile OTP.
They apply for leave, raise queries and update goals.
Managers approve for their department.
Finance approves payroll and payslips are published.

scenarios.title: Increment from April
scenarios.text: Schedule the revision in advance; it applies automatically when April payroll is calculated.

scenarios.title: Hybrid attendance
scenarios.text: Office staff use the kiosk; others check in from the portal, optionally with face verification.

faqs.a: Only if their role allows it. Custom roles can narrow access.

name: Manufacturing & Factories
short: Multiple shifts, overtime and fast gate attendance.
headline: Shift attendance and overtime for factories
intro: Large numbers of workers on several shifts need fast check-in, correct late marks and overtime that reaches payroll.
challenges: Queues at the gate at shift change.
Workers on morning, evening and night shifts.
Overtime calculated by hand.
Weekly offs that differ by shift.

features.why: Quick face recognition keeps the gate moving.
Multiple shifts with their own timings and weekly offs.
Late, half-day and early-leaving rules per shift.
Approved overtime hours become a payroll formula input.
Daily absentee and late-comer reports.

workflow: Workers scan at the gate kiosk.
Status is decided from their assigned shift.
Supervisors approve overtime.
Payroll pays overtime through your own formula.

scenarios.title: Shift change for a week
scenarios.text: Assign a different shift for a date range; attendance follows it for those days only.

scenarios.title: Overtime rate
scenarios.text: Use OT hours in a salary column formula, e.g. hourly rate × 2 × OT hours.

faqs.q: Do you support rotating shift patterns?
faqs.a: You can assign shifts by date range. Automatic rotation is not built in.

name: Healthcare Organizations
short: Round-the-clock shifts, rosters and credential documents.
headline: Rosters and records for clinics and hospitals
intro: Nursing and support staff work around the clock, and their registrations and certificates must be on file.
challenges: Day, evening and night rosters.
Licences and certificates to keep on record.
Many staff categories with different pay.

features.why: Roster calendar for every ward or team.
Staff upload certificates; HR verifies them.
Different structures per staff category.
Check-in and check-out times per shift.

workflow: Plan the month's roster.
Staff check in by face or portal.
HR verifies documents.
Payroll runs per category.

scenarios.title: Certificate on file
scenarios.text: Ask staff to upload registration documents; pending items are visible at a glance.

scenarios.title: Night shift timings
scenarios.text: Shift timings are configurable per weekday.

faqs.a: Not automatically yet; documents are stored and verified.

name: Retail & Hospitality
short: Several outlets, part-time staff and cash wages.
headline: HR for shops, outlets and hotels
intro: Outlet staff work varied timings, some are paid in cash, and managers need simple tools on a phone.
challenges: Staff across several outlets.
Some staff paid in cash.
High joining and leaving.

features.why: A phone or tablet at each outlet as a kiosk.
Quick self-registration and approval for new joiners.
Cash-paid staff left out of the bank file automatically.
Different timings for weekdays and weekends.

workflow: New staff register from their phone.
They check in at the outlet kiosk.
Payroll pays bank and cash staff correctly.
Exit clearance on leaving.

scenarios.title: Cash wages
scenarios.text: Mark an employee as cash-paid; they stay on payroll but not in the bank file.

scenarios.title: Weekend timings
scenarios.text: Use per-day shift timings for longer weekend hours.

faqs.q: Can each outlet have its own camera?
faqs.a: Yes, each scan records which camera took it.

name: Small and Medium Businesses
short: Everything in one place without an HR team.
headline: Payroll and attendance without a full HR department
intro: Owners and accountants who handle HR on the side need something that is quick to set up and hard to get wrong.
challenges: No dedicated HR person.
Salaries worked out in Excel each month.
Staff asking for payslips.

features.why: Attendance totals ready at month end.
Salaries, payslips and bank file in a few clicks.
Staff apply for leave from their phone.
Import your existing staff list from Excel.

workflow: Import staff from Excel.
Staff mark attendance from the portal or a kiosk.
Calculate payroll at month end.
Publish payslips.

scenarios.title: First month
scenarios.text: Enter last month's days by hand; switch to attendance-only from the month you choose.

faqs.a: Most small teams are set up in a day once salary structures are decided.
